```{python}
standard_height = 4
def compute_height(n):
    if n is None:
        n = 3
    if n == 3:
        h = standard_height - 1
    elif n == 2:
        h = standard_height - 2
    elif n == 1:
        h = standard_height - 3
    else:
        h = standard_height
    return max(h, 3)
```

```{python, results='asis'}

from IPython.display import Markdown, display
from pathlib import Path



# Loop through plots
for plot_name, bars, head in zip(meta, num_bars, header):
    fig_height = compute_height(bars)
    display(Markdown(f"## {head}"))
    display(Markdown(f"![](plots/{plot_name}_plot.pdf){{height={fig_height}in}}"))
```
